CHANGELOG updated in IDUNA: feat(nock): v0 layered image editor -- internal/nock (ImageMagick-backed engine: layers/masks/opacity/gradients/hue-sat/sharpen/resize/export), cmd/nock CLI, internal/http/handlers/nock.go JSON API, and a React 19+TypeScript SPA at /admin/nock (go:embed'd, iduna.admin-gated). Deliberately not GFD-coupled. 13 tests, all against real ImageMagick. Founder: 'we are gonna need to build our own tools to create the textures... lets yolo it into iduna... this project is called NOCK.' See docs/NOCK_NORTHSTAR.md for the phased plan. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
